title: On-the-Spot Surrealism
content: I have an article in the new issue ofInternational Artist(#108 April/May) called "On-the-Spot Surrealism."I share tips for putting an imaginative twist on your plein-air painting—not just fantasy and science fiction ideas, but also changing the lighting, pose, or background of what's in front of you.----More on this approach to outdoor painting in my tutorialFantasy in the WildBuy now
